predictions: Oh, this is getting a little sad. Last week I matched my pretty crappy week 3 record with a 13-10 record. Dang, that's so not the goal rate here. That takes me to 101-58 for the season (63.5% correct), which is… disappointing. And I would love to point at the culprits, but it's… almost the entirety of B, C and D divisions! I'm no better than 11-10 in any of those divisions, and there is only one team in each division that I appear to understand (Serious, McGavin, and Off Constantly).

Match of the week: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Ton 80 Proof. Ton 80 has been on fire for six weeks, sitting a match (and a handful of points in front of anyone else in F). But note that I didn't say for all seven weeks. That's because in week 1, the Sofa Kings doubled up Ton 80 for their only loss. Now, Sofa is among that pair just a match (plus a bunch of points) off the lead. I think Ton 80 gets a touch of payback here, 14-10.

Match #2: (B Div.) Blindsided @ Double In, Uber Out. Blindsided showed up shorthanded and got flat out whomped last week. But that has only dropped them into this head-to-head battle for 2nd. Somehow, these two both have losing cricket records though. How in the heck? Anyway, Uber's favorite thing is flipping one of my picks, so we'll make them happy and gamble they can't steal another in 501. Blind, 13-11.

Match #3: (C Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Nine Lives. C is just an awesome race. The super-mess outcomes didn't come to fruition last week, but C is still led by a team that loses a third of its matches and averages only 13.5 per week. The last place team averages more than 10.1. This is nuts. And means every match is big… so one between two of the lead trio must be friggin' huge, right?! I think Trippn win a 3rd straight, 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ DD-214. With the Bandits losing to a 2-win team last week, this matchup for 2nd place will put a team alone no more than one win off the lead. Off Constantly has 11+ in every match and is looking stout, so I'll take them here, 14-10.

Match #5: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Iceman's Ear Defenders. Yep, this is the B leader and a team a full three matches behind. But Iceman leads B in ASPs, and has two of the top five players in this division. Major possible landmine here, but I think Serious avoids it ok, 14-10.

Match #6: (A Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Liver Alliance. "Special" case pick in this one, as this is actually a double-header!! (They are making up the week 1 special postponement, then playing the regular one). The crazy part is that by the end of the night either team could be sitting in 3rd alone. Liver is too deep and wins both.

Match #7: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ Show Me Your Tips. Next to last vs. next to first is important and interesting? In C division, it certainly is. If Rif Raf could figure out how to pair for DCkt, they could win this division. But until they do, I'm staying with Show Me, 15-9.

Match #8: (G Div.) Nein Mark @ Punk in Drublic. With Rippin on a solo mission to the title, this pairing becomes a key part of the remaining G race, which is… roughly everyone, for everything from second to last. First time we've seen this pairing! Punk it is, 13-11.

Match #9: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Death Throw. For two teams sitting at exactly 0.500 at the midpoint, this might be the week that decides which race they are in during the second half. Death Throw feels like they want to be in the top-half battle, so let's go with DT, 15-9.

Match #10: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Neither of these teams wants to fall into the race to avoid the bottom-two, and both desperately want to climb back to the title fight. Already a must-win situation, it seems. Matt's Tab gets some 1001 payback?
Match #11: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Shooter McGavin. Yep, in C even a match of 2-4 teams in the bottom three is actually part of the title chase. Awesome. Sanchez's attendance rebounds? 15-9.
Match #12: (B Div.) Dysfunctional Outlaws @ Boom Baby. Being two matches behind 6th means this loser might already be relegated to a bottom-two finish. Winner might not be though! Boom, 13-11.
